title: A range, price in the middle: stand aside
why: The stand-aside case (item 4 of 3.10, the data side). M15 and M5 are both flat and the price is inside both corridors. Rule 4 gives STAND_ASIDE (archetype D) to both trader types: the Day Trader through MCD1's range, the Scalper through the middle of MCD2's range. No zones are built (NOT_DIRECTIONAL), there are no modal pills, and the reading says stand_aside. Report 1 cannot give a direction; the validator that enforces it is Section 5 (build step 7).
